payload.claim: In the open HEA FCGR dataset, threshold resistance and post-threshold crack-growth stability are decoupled: FCC+BCC records have higher median ΔKth than FCC records, but also much steeper median Paris slopes.
payload.science_value: For HEA fatigue design, screening by ΔKth alone can select alloys with poor post-threshold crack-growth stability; a two-axis threshold-slope map is the scientifically relevant descriptor.
